obligations: outline.entry and outline.entry.body are public static native identities
outline.entry constructs level, element and optional fill and rejects level below one
query(outline.entry) exposes one entry per included heading per realized outline
entry.element preserves the realized heading and entry.body preserves content morphology
the default fill is repeat(body: [.], gap: 0.15em)
depth and outlined:false constrain materialized entries
